title: Experts disagree on VoyageEmbeddingProvider in src/rag/providers.ts
context:
Chief architect: The three claims do not really conflict and all three should hold. The key-handling rule is the load-bearing one. The timeout is also carried by the accepted EX-integration-architect-3. The test shape in the third claim is right except for input_type: today's code sends only {input, model}, and EX-integration-architect-4 shows adding input_type changes the vectors, so the request must not send it.

Target: VoyageEmbeddingProvider in src/rag/providers.ts
- security-auditor: VOYAGE_API_KEY is sent only in the Authorization header to the fixed host https://api.voyageai.com, never in the URL, the request body, a progress message or a log line, and the endpoint host is not read from project config
- security-auditor: the Voyage fetch call needs an AbortSignal timeout, because global fetch has no default timeout and the voyageai SDK it replaces did; without it a stalled connection hangs Build the index
- qa-engineer: Given VOYAGE_API_KEY is set and global fetch is stubbed, when embed(['a','b']) runs, then exactly one POST goes to https://api.voyageai.com/v1/embeddings with header Authorization: Bearer <key>, body {input, model} (input_type only when set), and the returned vectors equal data[].embedding in input order. Proof: unit (vi.stubGlobal fetch).
